about_the_game:
TO THE MOON is a fast-paced vertical platformer that challenges your precision and timing. Your character starts in the center of the screen and must leap from platform to platform, climbing ever higher towards the luminous moon. Each jump requires perfect timing, as shifting platforms test your skills with every step upward.

Key Features: • Precise Timing: Enjoy smooth, responsive controls that demand your utmost precision with every leap. • Progressive Challenge: As you ascend, platforms become more unpredictable and challenging, keeping the gameplay intense and engaging. • Intuitive Controls: Easy to learn and accessible for players of all ages, ensuring fun for beginners and pros alike. • Captivating Visuals & Audio: Immerse yourself in stunning 2D graphics and dynamic sound effects that elevate your lunar adventure.
